title: Option to add Application Menu as a submenu for the standard context menu
line: The desktop's standard right-click menu can now show an Applications submenu, enabled from its Mouse Actions settings.
explanation: The desktop's application menu existed only as its own mouse action (Application Launcher), so binding it to right-click replaced the standard context menu entirely. The Standard Menu plugin had no entry for it, so there was no way to have both. The change adds an "Applications" entry to the Standard Menu plugin, unchecked by default, listed in its settings next to the other optional entries; when enabled it shows the application categories as a submenu, built fresh each time it opens, and launches the chosen app.

commits.message:
containmentactions/contextmenu: add optional Applications submenu

The application menu could only be bound to a mouse button on its own,
replacing the standard menu. Add an Applications entry, off by default,
that people can enable in the standard menu to browse and launch apps.

BUG: 479282

media.caption: Desktop right-click menu: no way to reach applications
